name: Simitçi Sahin
description: The taste of Istanbul, on and off the track.
story: Simitçi Sahin has been a beloved Istanbul street food vendor for over 30 years, known for their fresh, sesame-crusted simit. As a family business deeply rooted in the community, they see motorsport sponsorship as a way to connect with a wider audience and celebrate Turkish pride. They are looking for a team that embodies the same spirit of hard work and dedication.
